symbols.name: strength_reduced_profile
symbols.doc:
Copy of ``profile`` with tan(phi') and c' divided by ``factor`` in every layer.

This is the way USACE EM 1110-2-2504 (para. 5-2d, Table 5-1) applies its factor of safety on
passive pressure ("effective" phi and c). Undrained strengths (s_u) are left unchanged: for
those the pressure is linear in s_u and dividing the whole force by the factor is the
smaller (safer) value, so ``min`` of the two methods picks it.

symbols.name: _evaluate
symbols.doc:
Value of a piecewise-linear diagram at depths z (absolute); zero outside its range.

At a jump (duplicate node) the value just below is returned, or just above where the
boolean array ``left`` is True.

symbols.name: net_pressure
symbols.doc:
Net pressure diagram. ``active_factor``, ``surcharge_factor`` and ``water_factor`` are
load factors on the soil, surcharge and water parts of the driving pressure (partial
factor design); the passive side is divided by ``passive_factor`` (see the module docstring).

Seismic (simplified): ``seismic_increment`` [kPa] is a uniform dynamic pressure added
behind the wall over the retained height H (resultant at H/2, TBDY 16.12.2.8);
``seismic_increment_below`` is the horizontal dynamic coefficient increment
Delta K_h = (1 - kv) K_AE,h - K_A,h (>= 0) applied to the retained effective vertical stress
plus surcharge below the dredge line, where the M-O active pressure also acts on the
embedded part (Ebeling & Morrison 1992); ``passive_seismic_ratio`` (K_PE / K_P <= 1) scales the
passive effective pressure.

``backfill_slope`` [deg] is the retained ground slope beta (active side only; the front
ground stays horizontal). Rankine uses the slope coefficient with the resultant parallel to
the surface; c' is dropped on sloping ground with a warning. ``surcharge`` is per horizontal
projection (see ``surcharge_per_horizontal``).

``passive_strength_reduction`` applies the global factor of safety the USACE EM 1110-2-2504
way as well (tan(phi') and c' divided by ``passive_factor``) and takes the smaller passive
pressure; it is for global-FS (ASD) design, not for partial factors on the resistance
(EN 1997-1 gamma_R;e, KDYY gamma_Re), which divide the force only.

``seismic_dk`` (Delta K_ad = K_AE,total - K_A,static) with ``seismic_toe`` [m] is the KDYY
handbook increment: a uniform 0.5 Delta K_ad sigma'_v(toe) over the whole wall length
0..toe (AASHTO 2010) plus a triangular surcharge part 2 q Delta K_ad (1 - z/toe)
(Kumbasar & Kip). It replaces ``seismic_increment`` and ``seismic_increment_below``; the toe
depth is part of the solution, so the solvers iterate on it. ``seismic_toe=None`` adds nothing.

``passive_width_ratio`` (<= 1) is the effective passive width over the member spacing for
soldier pile walls; it scales the effective passive pressure only, not the water.

(force, arm below the base bottom) of a piecewise-linear passive diagram over the key.

``z`` is the depth below the front ground; the key face spans ``embedment`` to
``embedment + depth``. Jumps at layer boundaries appear as repeated ``z`` values.

symbols.name: key_sliding_basic
symbols.doc:
Shear key passive resistance and key-tip plane data for a homogeneous foundation.

Rankine passive on the key front face from the front ground (``embedment`` above the base
bottom) down to the key bottom: p_p = K_p sigma_v + 2 c sqrt(K_p) (K_p = 1 and s_u for
undrained soil), sigma_v = gamma_front D + gamma_foundation (z - D), multiplied by the passive
reduction factor and, in the seismic case, by the M-O passive ratio.

symbols.name: key_zone_thrust_basic
symbols.doc:
Active thrust between the base level and the key-tip plane on the vertical line through
the heel (homogeneous backfill over the foundation soil).

The plane through the key tip extends the sliding block below the base, so the retained side
pushes on it down to the key bottom. Layer-local Coulomb coefficients with delta = beta on that
vertical soil plane (Rankine-equivalent), the same convention as the layered wall path; c' is
ignored by the Coulomb solution (conservative). Only the horizontal component is used.

symbols.name: key_band_force

symbols.name: strip_key

symbols.name: key_result
symbols.doc:
Governing surface = smaller ratio. ``rb``/``rd`` already include all passives;

symbols.name: evaluate_checks

ASD checks. With a shear key, sliding takes the smaller of two surfaces: (a) the base
interface (V tan(delta_b) + c_a B') plus the key passive, (b) a horizontal plane through the key
tip ((V + W_soil) tan(phi) + c B' + key passive); toe passive, if used, acts on both.

symbols.name: wall_global_stability
symbols.doc:
Critical Bishop circle and the global stability check.

By default the required FS comes from the ASD design code. For partial-factor design the
caller passes design-strength divisors (applied to tan phi and c of every band and the
backfill) and the required factor (e.g. gamma_R;e, or 1/phi for LRFD).

``retained_bands`` supplies the horizontally layered retained mass above the base.
Its first band extends upward to the sloping surface. None keeps the legacy model.
``surcharge_factor`` applies to the surface surcharge; ``footprint_factors``
supplies unfavourable DC/EV factors for carried loads. Slice soil weights stay
characteristic; DA1-C1/DA2 soil-weight factoring and vertical inertia are not modelled.

expr: "R = ∫₀^(H+D0) p_net(z) dz      (perde ucundaki yoğunlaşmış kuvvet)\nD = D0 × (1 + artış)      (konsol varsayılan artış = 0.20)",

{ text: { tr: "Aktif basınç: p_a(z) = K_a·γ·z (z ≤ H + D0). Pasif basınç: p_p(z) = K_p·γ·(z − H) (z > H). Net: p_net = p_a − p_p.", en: "Active pressure: p_a(z) = K_a·γ·z (z ≤ H + D0). Passive pressure: p_p(z) = K_p·γ·(z − H) (z > H). Net: p_net = p_a − p_p." }, expr: "p_a = K_a·γ·z,  p_p = K_p·γ·(z − H)" },

{ text: { tr: "Perde ucuna göre moment: aktif resultante K_a·γ·(H+D0)²/2 kolu (H+D0)/3; pasif resultante K_p·γ·D0²/2 kolu D0/3. Denge: aktif moment = pasif moment.", en: "Moment about the wall tip: active resultant K_a·γ·(H+D0)²/2 with arm (H+D0)/3; passive resultant K_p·γ·D0²/2 with arm D0/3. Balance: active moment = passive moment." }, expr: "K_a·γ·(H+D0)³/6 = K_p·γ·D0³/6" },
{ text: { tr: "Her iki tarafı γ/6 ile sadeleştirip (H + D0)³ / D0³ oranını yazın.", en: "Cancel γ/6 on both sides and write the ratio (H + D0)³ / D0³." }, expr: "(H + D0)³ / D0³ = K_p / K_a" },
{ text: { tr: "Kübik kök alıp D0 için çözün (r = (K_a / K_p)^(1/3)):", en: "Take the cube root and solve for D0 (r = (K_a / K_p)^(1/3)):" }, expr: "D0 = H · r / (1 − r)" },
{ label: { tr: "Oran r", en: "Ratio r" }, expr: "r = (K_a / K_p)^(1/3) = (1/9)^(1/3)", result: "r = 0.4807" },
{ label: { tr: "Teorik gömme D0", en: "Theoretical D0" }, expr: "D0 = H · r / (1 − r) = 5 × 0.4807 / 0.5193", result: "D0 = 4.63 m" },
{ label: { tr: "Tasarım gömme D", en: "Design D" }, expr: "D = 1.2 × D0 = 1.2 × 4.63", result: "D = 5.56 m (perde boyu H + D = 10.56 m)" },

{ label: { tr: "Perde ucundaki R (magnitüd)", en: "Toe force magnitude" }, expr: "|R| = ½·γ·[K_a(H+D0)² − K_p·D0²] = ½ × 18 × [(1/3)(9.63)² − 3 × 4.63²]", result: "|R| ≈ 300.4 kN/m (işaret: negatif, bölüm 3 notuna bakın)" },
expr: "p_pasif,tasarım = p_pasif / GS      (GS ≥ 1)",
{ label: { tr: "Teorik gömme D0", en: "D0 with GS" }, expr: "D0 = 5 × 0.5503 / (1 − 0.5503) = 2.7516 / 0.4497", result: "D0 = 6.12 m (Örnek 2’de 4.63 m idi)" },
{ label: { tr: "Tasarım D", en: "Design D" }, expr: "D = 1.2 × 6.12", result: "D = 7.34 m" },
{ label: { tr: "Moment: z0 (kesme sıfır)", en: "Shear-zero depth" }, expr: "z0 = H·√K_p,t / (√K_p,t − √K_a) = 5 × √2 / (√2 − √(1/3))", result: "z0 = 8.45 m (kazı tabanından 3.45 m aşağı)" },
expr: "V(z) = ∫₀^z p_net(s) ds,    M(z) = ∫₀^z V(s) ds      (konsol, kesme sıfır olduğu derinlikte M_max)",
{ label: { tr: "Kesme sıfır derinliği", en: "Shear-zero depth" }, expr: "z0 = 5 × √3 / (√3 − √(1/3)) = 8.660 / 1.1547", result: "z0 = 7.50 m" },
{ label: { tr: "Küpler", en: "Cubes" }, expr: "z0³ = 421.875;  (z0 − H)³ = 2.5³ = 15.625", result: "—" },
sources: [
expr: "∫₀^(H+D0) p_net(z)·(z − z_a) dz = 0",
expr: "T = ∫₀^(H+D0) p_net(z) dz   (T > 0 olmalıdır)",
expr: "P_ankraj = T · s / cos θ",
type: "example",
expr: "Σ M_ankraj = ∫₀^(H+D) p_net(z)·(z − z_a) dz = 0",

{ label: { tr: "Deneme 3: D = 1.9 m (kökün yakını)", en: "Trial 3: D = 1.9 m" }, expr: "f(1.9) = 6·[(6.9³)/3 − (6.9²)/2] − 54·[1.9³/3 + 4·1.9²/2] = 6 × 85.70 − 54 × 9.51", result: "f ≈ +0.8 kNm/m (≈ 0; küçük pozitif artık)" },
{ label: { tr: "Sonuç D0", en: "Result D0" }, expr: "f(1.9) ≈ +0.8 ve f(1.9023) ≈ 0 → D0 ≈ 1.902 m", result: "D0 = 1.90 m (tasarım = D0)" },
{ label: { tr: "Yatay denge: T", en: "Horizontal equilibrium: T" }, expr: "T = ½·K_a·γ·(H+D)² − ½·K_p·γ·D² = 3 × 6.902² − 27 × 1.902²", result: "T = 142.9 − 97.7 = 45.2 kN/m" },
expr: "T = ∫₀^(H+D) p_net(z) dz      (T > 0 olmalıdır)\nP_ankraj = T · s / cos θ",
{ label: { tr: "Yatay kuvvet", en: "Horizontal force" }, expr: "T = 45.22 kN/m", result: "45.22 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "Tek ankraj yükü", en: "Load per anchor" }, expr: "P = T · s / cos θ = 45.22 × 2 / cos 15°", result: "P = 90.43 / 0.9659" },
{ label: { tr: "Sonuç", en: "Result" }, expr: "P ≈ 93.6 kN", result: "93.6 kN per anchor" },
expr: "z0 = √(2T / (K_a·γ))      (kazı tabanının üstünde, z0 < H ise)\nM_max = T·(z0 − z_a) − K_a·γ·z0³ / 6",
{ label: { tr: "Kesme sıfır derinliği", en: "Shear zero depth" }, expr: "z0 = √(2 × 45.22 / 6) = √15.07", result: "z0 = 3.88 m (kazı tabanının 1.12 m üstünde)" },
{ label: { tr: "Moment", en: "Moment" }, expr: "M_max = 45.22 × (3.88 − 1) − 6 × 3.88³ / 6 = 130.3 − 58.5", result: "M_max ≈ 71.8 kNm/m" },
{ label: { tr: "Konsol ile karşılaştırma", en: "Compare with cantilever" }, expr: "konsol M_max = 281.25 kNm/m (önceki konu, aynı H ve zemin)", result: "ankraj momenti yaklaşık %74 düşürdü" },
sources: [
expr: "T = T_h · s / cos α ,   T_h = q_h · s   (GEC-4 denk. 19-20)",
expr: "T_v = T · sin α   (GEC-4 denk. 21)",
expr: "k = tan(45° − φ′/2);   x = (H + e − z_h) · k / (1 + k · tan α);   L_kama = x / cos α",
expr: "χ_eksen = χ / sin(45° + φ′/2 + α)   ;   L_serbest = max( L_kama + χ_eksen ; L_min )",
expr: "L_kök = max( T · FS / q_u ; L_kök,min ) ,   q_u = π · d_h · τ_ult  (veya doğrudan q_u)",
type: "example",
expr: "T_tasarım ≤ 0,60 · SMTS ;   T_kilit ≤ 0,70 · SMTS ;   T_deneme = 1,33 · T ≤ 0,80 · SMTS",
expr: "T = T_h · s / cos α   ,   T_v = T · sin α",
{ label: { tr: "Yatay yük (bir ankraj)", en: "Horizontal load per anchor" }, expr: "T_h · s = 172 × 2,5", result: "430 kN" },
{ label: { tr: "Eksenel tasarım yükü", en: "Design axial load" }, expr: "T = 430 / cos 15° = 430 / 0,96593", result: "445,17 kN" },
{ label: { tr: "Düşey bileşen", en: "Vertical component" }, expr: "T_v = 445,17 × sin 15° = 445,17 × 0,25882", result: "115,22 kN" },
{ label: { tr: "Kilitleme yükü (örnek girdi: oran 1,0)", en: "Lock-off load (example input ratio 1.0)" }, expr: "P_kilit = 1,0 × 445,17", result: "445,17 kN" },
{ label: { tr: "Deneme yükü", en: "Test load" }, expr: "P_deneme = 1,33 × 445,17", result: "592,07 kN" },
expr: "k = tan(45° − φ′/2) ;   x = (H + e − z_h) · k / (1 + k · tan α) ;   L_kama = x / cos α",
expr: "χ_eksen = χ / sin(45° + φ′/2 + α) ;   L_serbest = max( L_kama + χ_eksen ;  L_min )",
{ label: { tr: "A: kama uzunluğu", en: "A: wedge length" }, expr: "L_kama = 1,7775 / cos 15° = 1,7775 / 0,96593", result: "1,840 m" },
{ label: { tr: "χ ankraj ekseni boyunca", en: "chi along axis" }, expr: "χ_eksen = 2,0 / sin(76,5°) = 2,0 / 0,97237", result: "2,0568 m" },
{ label: { tr: "A: gerekli serbest boy ve sonuç", en: "A: required free length" }, expr: "L_gerekli = 1,840 + 2,057 = 3,897 < 4,5 → L_serbest = 4,5 m (minimum belirleyici)", result: "4,50 m" },
{ label: { tr: "B: x ve kama uzunluğu (yükseklik 7,5 m)", en: "B: x and wedge length" }, expr: "x = 7,5 × 0,54296 / 1,14548 = 3,5550 m ;  L_kama = 3,5550 / 0,96593", result: "3,680 m" },
{ label: { tr: "B: gerekli serbest boy", en: "B: required free length" }, expr: "L_gerekli = 3,680 + 2,057 = 5,737 > 4,5 → kama belirleyici", result: "5,74 m" },
expr: "L_kök = max( T · FS / q_u ;  L_kök,min )   ,   q_u = π · d_h · τ_ult",
{ label: { tr: "Zemin: hesaplanan kök boyu", en: "Soil: calculated bond length" }, expr: "L_kök = 445,17 × 2,0 / 100 = 8,903", result: "8,90 m" },
{ label: { tr: "Zemin: minimum (4,5 m) ile karşılaştırma", en: "Soil: compare with minimum" }, expr: "8,90 > 4,5 → hesap belirleyici", result: "8,90 m" },
{ label: { tr: "Zemin: ankraj kapasitesi", en: "Soil: allowable capacity" }, expr: "Q = q_u · L_kök / FS = 100 × 8,903 / 2,0", result: "445,17 kN (= T)" },
{ label: { tr: "Kaya: hesaplanan kök boyu", en: "Rock: calculated bond length" }, expr: "L_kök = 445,17 × 3,0 / 730 = 1,829", result: "1,83 m" },
{ label: { tr: "Kaya: minimum belirleyici", en: "Rock: minimum governs" }, expr: "1,83 < 4,5 (halat) → L_kök = 4,5 m", result: "4,50 m (minimum)" },
expr: "T ≤ 0,60 · SMTS ;   P_kilit ≤ 0,70 · SMTS ;   P_deneme = 1,33 · T ≤ 0,80 · SMTS",
{ label: { tr: "2 halat: toplam SMTS", en: "Two strands: total SMTS" }, expr: "SMTS = 2 × 260,7 = 521,4 kN", result: "521,4 kN" },
{ label: { tr: "2 halat: tasarım sınırı", en: "Two strands: design limit" }, expr: "0,60 × 521,4 = 312,8 kN < 445,17 → yetmez", result: "2 halat yetersiz" },

{ label: { tr: "3 halat: toplam SMTS ve sınırlar", en: "Three strands: total SMTS and limits" }, expr: "SMTS = 782,1 kN ; 0,60 × 782,1 = 469,3 ≥ 445,17 ✓ ; 0,70 × 782,1 = 547,5 ≥ 445,17 ✓ ; 0,80 × 782,1 = 625,7 ≥ 592,07 ✓", result: "3 halat yeterli" },
{ label: { tr: "3 halat: kullanım oranları", en: "Three strands: utilisation" }, expr: "T / SMTS = 445,17 / 782,1 = 0,569 ; P_deneme / SMTS = 592,07 / 782,1 = 0,757", result: "0,57 ve 0,76" },

{ label: { tr: "Örtü: kök merkezi derinliği (z_h = 6,25 m, L_serbest = 4,5, L_kök = 8,903)", en: "Cover: bond centre depth" }, expr: "z = 6,25 + (4,5 + 8,903/2) × sin 15° = 6,25 + 8,952 × 0,25882", result: "8,57 m ≥ 4,5 m ✓" },
sources: [
expr: "p = 0,65 · Ka · γ · H² / (H − H1/3 − Hn+1/3)   ;   ek sürşarj: Ka · q",
type: "example",
expr: "N_s = γ · H / S_u,b",
type: "example",
type: "example",
type: "example",
expr: "FS_1 = N_c · S_u,b / (γH + q − S_u·H/B′)   ;   FS_2 = N_c · S_u,b / (γH + q)",
type: "example",
{ label: { tr: "Toplam kuvvet", en: "Total thrust" }, expr: "P = 0,65 × 0,3333 × 18 × 10² = 0,65 × 0,3333 × 1800 = 390", result: "390 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "Zarf ordinatı", en: "Envelope ordinate" }, expr: "p_max = 390 / (10 − 1,5/3 − 2,5/3) = 390 / (10 − 0,5 − 0,8333) = 390 / 8,6667", result: "45,0 kPa" },
{ label: { tr: "Menteşe yükleri (program ile aynı, toplam 390 kN/m)", en: "Hinge loads" }, expr: "T_1 = 120,625 ; T_2 = 126,875 ; T_3 = 115,417 kN/m", result: "Σ T = 362,917" },
{ label: { tr: "Tabana aktarılan kuvvet (R_B) ve kontrol", en: "Base reaction and check" }, expr: "R_B = 390 − 362,917 = 27,083 ; Σ T + R_B = 390 ✓", result: "27,08 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "Ankraj eksenel yükü (eğim 0°, aralık 2,5 m)", en: "Axial load per anchor" }, expr: "P_1 = 120,625 × 2,5 / cos 0° = 301,56 kN", result: "301,56 kN" },
{ label: { tr: "Toplam zarf", en: "Total envelope" }, expr: "P = 390 kN/m (Örnek 1 ile aynı)", result: "390 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "Ankraj 1 katkı alanı", en: "Anchor 1 tributary" }, expr: "T_1 = 112,5 kN/m (alan birimi kN/m)", result: "112,50" },
{ label: { tr: "Ankraj 2 katkı alanı", en: "Anchor 2 tributary" }, expr: "T_2 = 135,0 kN/m", result: "135,00" },
{ label: { tr: "Ankraj 3 katkı alanı", en: "Anchor 3 tributary" }, expr: "T_3 = 121,406 kN/m", result: "121,41" },
{ label: { tr: "Tabana kalan", en: "Base reaction" }, expr: "R_B = 390 − (112,5 + 135,0 + 121,406) = 21,094", result: "21,09 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "γH", en: "gamma H" }, expr: "γH = 17 × 8 = 136", result: "136 kPa" },
{ label: { tr: "Stabilite sayısı", en: "Stability number" }, expr: "N_s = 136 / 30 = 4,533", result: "4 < 4,533 < 5,14 → yumuşak kil" },
{ label: { tr: "K_a (sabit)", en: "K_a" }, expr: "K_a = 0,22", result: "0,22" },
{ label: { tr: "Ordinat", en: "Ordinate" }, expr: "p_max = 0,22 × 136 = 29,92", result: "29,92 kPa" },
{ label: { tr: "Toplam (zarf alanı; z = 0 → 2 m rampa, 2 → 8 m sabit)", en: "Total thrust" }, expr: "P = ½ × 2 × 29,92 + (8 − 2) × 29,92 = 29,92 + 179,52", result: "209,44 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "c = 0,4: ordinat", en: "c = 0.4: ordinate" }, expr: "p = 0,4 × 17 × 8 = 54,4", result: "54,4 kPa" },
{ label: { tr: "Zarf uzunluğu", en: "Envelope length" }, expr: "H − H1/3 − H_n+1/3 = 8 − 2/3 − 3/3 = 6,333", result: "6,333 m" },
{ label: { tr: "c = 0,2: ordinat ve toplam", en: "c = 0.2: ordinate and total" }, expr: "p = 0,2 × 17 × 8 = 27,2 ; P = 27,2 × 6,333 = 172,27 < 192", result: "172,27 → 192 (3H²)" },
{ label: { tr: "c = 0,2: düzeltilmiş ordinat", en: "c = 0.2: corrected ordinate" }, expr: "p = 192 / 6,333 = 30,32", result: "30,32 kPa" },
expr: "FS = N_c · s_u / (γH + q)   (denk. 37, derinlik mekanizması)",
{ label: { tr: "Etkin genişlik", en: "Effective width" }, expr: "B' = B / √2 = 10 / 1,4142 = 7,071 m", result: "7,071 m" },
{ label: { tr: "N_c (Skempton tarzı, H/B = 0,6)", en: "N_c" }, expr: "N_c = 5 × (1 + 0,2 × 0,6) = 5,6 (kodun ve testin kullandığı değer; bağıntının kaynak metnini doğrulayamadım)", result: "5,6" },
{ label: { tr: "Derinlik mekanizması (denk. 37)", en: "Depth mechanism" }, expr: "FS = 5,6 × 20 / (17 × 6 + 0) = 112 / 102", result: "1,098" },
{ label: { tr: "Yan kesme mekanizması (denk. 35, N_c = 5,0)", en: "Side-shear mechanism" }, expr: "FS = 5,0 × 20 / (102 − 20 × 6 / 7,071) = 100 / 85,03", result: "1,176" },
{ label: { tr: "Belirleyici ve karar", en: "Governing and decision" }, expr: "min(1,098 ; 1,176) = 1,098 < 1,5 (geçici) → yetersiz", result: "1,098 — başarısız" },
{ label: { tr: "Taşıma faktörü (grafik, H/B = 5)", en: "N_c from chart" }, expr: "N_c ≈ 7,46 (Skempton 7,5 ile sınırlanmış grafik değeri)", result: "7,46" },
{ label: { tr: "Derinlik mekanizması (denk. 37)", en: "Depth mechanism" }, expr: "FS = 7,46 × 30 / (18 × 10) = 223,8 / 180", result: "1,2433" },
{ label: { tr: "Karar (geçici)", en: "Decision (temporary)" }, expr: "1,2433 < 1,5 → yetersiz", result: "başarısız" },
sources: [
expr: "P_p = ½ · K_p · γ · D²   (diş derinliği D boyunca)",
expr: "FS_diş-ucu = R_düzlem / (H_itici + ΔH_diş)",
type: "example",
expr: "σ_v(z) = γ_ön · D + γ_temel · (z − D)      (dişin ön yüzündeki düşey gerilme, D ≤ z ≤ D + d)\np_p(z) = K_p · σ_v(z) + 2c · √K_p      (drenajlı; φ = 0 ise K_p = 1 ve c = s_u)",

{ label: { tr: "Dişin üst ve alt yüzündeki σ_v", en: "sigma_v at top and bottom of key" }, expr: "σ_v(üst) = 20 × 1.0 = 20 kPa;  σ_v(alt) = 20 + 20 × 1.43 = 48.6 kPa", result: "20 → 48.6 kPa (doğrusal)" },

{ label: { tr: "Pasif kuvvet integrali", en: "Passive integral" }, expr: "P_p = K_p · γ · (d + d²/2)  [σ_v ortalaması (20 + 48.6)/2 ile d = 1.43 çarpımı]", result: "P_p = 3.2546 × 20 × (1.43 + 1.0225) = 3.2546 × 49.05" },
{ label: { tr: "Toplam pasif (tam)", en: "Full passive" }, expr: "P_p(tam) = 159.6 kN/m", result: "yayımlanmış 159.4 kN/m ile %0.14 fark (K_p yuvarlaması)" },
{ label: { tr: "Kayma hesabında kullanılan", en: "Used in sliding" }, expr: "P_p(kullanılan) = 0.5 × 159.6", result: "79.8 kN/m" },
expr: "FS_base = (V·tan δ_b + R_pasif) / H_itici\nFS_diş-ucu = (V_blok·tan φ + R_pasif) / (H_itici + ΔH_diş)      (ΔH_diş: diş bölgesi arka itkisi)",
{ label: { tr: "Bant üstündeki basınç (taban seviyesi)", en: "Pressure at base level" }, expr: "σ_h,üst = K_a · σ_v = 0.3333 × 118", result: "39.3 kPa" },
{ label: { tr: "Dişin yüksekliği boyunca integral", en: "Integral over key depth" }, expr: "ΔH = (118 × 0.6 + ½ × 18 × 0.6²) / 3 = (70.8 + 3.24) / 3", result: "ΔH = 24.68 kN/m" },

{ label: { tr: "Yönetici yüzeyin değişimi", en: "Change of governing surface" }, expr: "FS_diş-ucu = (V_blok·tan φ + R) / (H_itici + ΔH)", result: "itici kuvvet 118.0 → 142.7 kN/m (sayılar aşağıda)" },
{ label: { tr: "Diş yok", en: "No key" }, expr: "FS = 319.56 × 0.5774 / 118.0", result: "FS = 1.56" },
{ label: { tr: "Diş var, taban yüzeyi", en: "With key, base surface" }, expr: "FS_base = (326.76 × 0.5774 + 29.16) / 118.0 = 217.8 / 118.0", result: "FS_base = 1.85" },

{ label: { tr: "Diş var, diş ucu düzlemi", en: "With key, key-tip plane" }, expr: "FS_deep = ((326.76 + 32.4) × 0.5774 + 29.16) / (118.0 + 24.68) = 236.6 / 142.7", result: "FS_deep = 1.66 (yönetici)" },
{ label: { tr: "Dişsiz duvarda diş ucu etkisi çıkarılsa", en: "Without the key-zone thrust" }, expr: "FS = 236.6 / 118.0", result: "2.00 (kontrol amaçlı; gerçek değil)" },
{ label: { tr: "σ_v", en: "sigma_v" }, expr: "σ_v(üst) = 0;  σ_v(alt) = 20 × 1.43 = 28.6 kPa", result: "0 → 28.6 kPa" },
{ label: { tr: "Pasif integral", en: "Passive integral" }, expr: "P_p = ½ · K_p · γ · d² = ½ × 3.2546 × 20 × 1.43²", result: "P_p = 66.55 kN/m" },
{ label: { tr: "Kullanılan (×0.5)", en: "Used (×0.5)" }, expr: "0.5 × 66.55", result: "33.3 kN/m" },
